issues.detail: The skill does not explicitly address error handling or edge cases such as missing sitemaps or failed network requests.
The instructions assume a Node.js environment with specific tooling (Playwright, Next.js), limiting portability to other platforms.

scenarios.name: full-migration-with-cms-and-blog
scenarios.rationale: Response B covers most rubric items, missing only CSV-to-MDX conversion, while Response A omits key steps like curl, Playwright, generateStaticParams, metadata export, and redirects.

scenarios.name: headless-store-rebuild
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers more rubric items (headless client, OAuthStrategy, productsV3, server components) than Response B, which focuses on cart/checkout but omits key headless setup details.

scenarios.name: velo-code-extraction
scenarios.rationale: Both responses miss the required use of `wix dev` to pull the Velo backend, but Response B more explicitly notes the separation of backend from visual layout and gives a clearer import path into Next.js, earning it a slightly higher score.
